comfyui-media-feed_placement.name: Placement
comfyui-media-feed_placement.tooltip: Choose where the floating Media Feed panel appears.

comfyui-media-feed_show-prompts.name: Show metadata in viewer
comfyui-media-feed_show-prompts.tooltip: Read embedded PNG, GIF, MP4, WebM, M4A, MP3, FLAC, OGG, or Opus metadata and show inferred prompt and seed metadata when viewing media.

comfyui-media-feed_media-scope.name: Media from
comfyui-media-feed_media-scope.tooltip: Show media from every workflow tab or only media queued from the currently active workflow tab.

comfyui-media-feed_scale-viewer-media.name: Fit media to viewer
comfyui-media-feed_scale-viewer-media.tooltip: Upscale small images and videos to the largest size that fits entirely within the viewer while preserving their aspect ratio.

comfyui-media-feed_show-favorite-button.name: Show favorite button on hover
comfyui-media-feed_show-favorite-button.tooltip: Show the favorite star in the upper-right corner of a feed card when you hover over it.

comfyui-media-feed_favorite-folder.name: Favorite storage folder
comfyui-media-feed_favorite-folder.tooltip: Favorites are always stored in the output/favorites folder and this location cannot be changed.
